name: preview-shells-runner
goal: Verification runs entity-preview-shells.spec.ts under the entity preview Playwright config, as it runs the other entity preview specs.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: harness.verify.json at bc6149a has no check for packages/reports/test/entity-preview-shells.spec.ts; verifyPlan falls back to bun x playwright test test/entity-preview-shells.spec.ts, whose default config (testDir tests/e2e) lists 0 tests, exit 1. Expected: the entity preview config, as for the four sibling specs.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: bunx vitest run test/preview-shells-runner.test.ts on unchanged config: 2 failed, 1 passed (guard). Received command bun x playwright test test/entity-preview-shells.spec.ts; expected ENTITY_PREVIEW_HOME=output/entity-preview ... --config test/entityPreviewPlaywright.ts. Log runner-fix/red.log, test sha256 36f0e329.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Added one harness.verify.json check for packages/reports/test/entity-preview-shells.spec.ts: ENTITY_PREVIEW_HOME=output/entity-preview bun x playwright test --config test/entityPreviewPlaywright.ts {target}; no timeout override; verifyPlan unchanged.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same regression (sha256 36f0e329) 3/3 passed (runner-fix/green.log). New command --list: 4 tests, exit 0; old command: 0 tests, exit 1. Focused resolver 17/17, verify-config readers 16/16, audit, units, explain check pass.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
